weeks.title: Weeks 1–2 · Month 1
tasks: Watch all 8 Month 1 lessons in order
Pick one pair ICT doesn't use (not EUR or GBP) for your daily log
Set up the charts: daily (9–12 months), 4-hour (3 months), 1-hour (3 weeks), 15-minute (3–4 days)
Each day for 10 days: mark fast moves, untested highs/lows and equal highs/lows
Record when each day's high and low formed, and which day and session made the weekly high and low
Find 5 past examples of a 62–79% OTE buy in discount

weeks.title: Weeks 3–4 · Month 2
tasks: Watch all 8 Month 2 lessons
Write your binary trade plan: when to buy, sell, or stay out
Write your risk rules: ≤1–2% per trade, halve after a loss
Open a demo account and calculate your break-even win rate for 3:1
Find 3 false-flag or false-breakout traps on your pair

weeks.title: Weeks 5–6 · Month 3
tasks: Watch all 8 Month 3 lessons
Choose your style and timeframe pair (position / swing / short-term / day)
Every Saturday: write the big-picture and intermediate view (2 of 4, 2 of 3)
Overlay DXY on your pair and log 3 SMT divergences
Mark the monthly range (last down and up candles) on 3 pairs

weeks.title: Weeks 7–9 · Month 4
tasks: Watch all 13 Month 4 lessons
Screenshot 5 examples of each: order block, breaker, FVG, rejection block, void
Label internal vs external range liquidity on every chart you study
Take demo trades: one setup per week with ≥40 pips of room
Log 10 demo trades in the Journal with screenshots

weeks.title: Weeks 10–12 · Month 5
tasks: Watch all 18 Month 5 lessons (IPDA Data Ranges twice)
On the 1st of the month: 20/40/60-day look-back and cast-forward on 3 pairs
Track the 10-year yield vs DXY: same direction or opposite?
Add the seasonal table to your calendar (this month and next)
Hold one demo position trade with 40/20-day trailing stops
Review the journal: is your expectancy positive after 30+ trades?
